verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an API-driven subscription lifecycle (pricing changes, trials, upgrades/downgrades, seat changes) and a published OpenAPI spec, supporting programmatic management without a dashboard. However, explicit create/pause/cancel endpoint documentation and hands-on confirmation of pause/cancel specifically are not shown. missing for 10: explicit docs/examples for 'pause' and 'cancel' subscription actions, independent developer confirmation of full lifecycle via API alone.
